messages:
maria: Kicking off cross-cloud org provisioning for the new customer (Orion Labs). Need a checklist that covers accounts/projects, IAM, billing export, tags, and quota requests for GPUs + networking. Who can pick this up?
ajay: I can start a consolidated checklist. Quick note: they want low-latency in US & EU and backups in APAC. That affects region quota needs.
lucy: Please include region preferences: us-west2 (primary), eu-west1 (secondary), asia-southeast1 (backup). Also note data residency constraints — EU must stay in eu-west1 when requested.
maria: Good. Also they asked about dedicated GPU capacity options and cost estimates for 8x A100-80GB or 16x A10s across two regions. Add cost bucket items.
sam: For quotas: AWS (p4d, p3dn, g4dn), GCP (a2, t4, a100 if multizone), Azure (NDv4/NCasT). Need to request both per-region GPU instance limits and vCPU/ENI limits so autoscaling doesn't choke.
darren: I can file AWS Service Quotas tickets. Which exact SKU counts? Maria: Start with a conservative request: p4d 8, p3dn 0 (not planned), g4dn 32; also increase EC2 running-instances and ENI per region to support burst autoscale.
ajay: I'll draft the GCP quota requests: `a2-highgpu-1g` CPUs and GPUs (8 GPUs), `accelerator.googleapis.com` quota increase to 8 in us-west2 and 4 in eu-west1. Include `CPUS` bump for the matching machine types.
lucy: Azure: request ND A100 v4 family quota to 8 in WestUS2 and 4 in NorthEurope. Also raise regional vCPU quota and Public IP addresses if we plan to use static outbound IPs for whitelisting.
maria: Networking checklist: VPCs per environment, shared services VPC, subnets sized for node pools, NAT gateways (or use egress proxy), route tables, VPC peering/privatelink, firewall baseline, and flow logs. Add ENI/Secondary IP considerations for AWS.
sam: Call out LB limits: Azure/ALB connection tracking, GCP forwarding rules quota, and AWS NLB ephemeral port limits. Also ensure internal load balancer quotas are bumped for expected node counts.
darren: File names for tickets: aws-quotas/orion-<region>-date, gcp-quotas/orion-<project>-date, azure-quotas/orion-<subscription>-date. I'll link PRs back here. :thumbsup:
maria: IAM & security: create a dedicated service account per env with least-privilege roles, enable org policy constraints (no external IPs on sensitive workloads), enable KMS key for secrets + CMEK for storage. Add SCIM for Okta provisioning.
ajay: Billing: link projects/subscriptions to the customer's billing account, enable billing export to BigQuery/Azure Cost Management, create monthly budget alerts at 60/80/95% thresholds, and set notification to infra-costs.
lucy: Tags/labels: required tags = ["cost-center","team","env","project","owner","workload-type"]. Enforce via policy/guardrails and include examples: `labels: {"cost-center":"orion-core","env":"prod","team":"orchestration"}`.
sam: Automation: add terraform module templates for account/project bootstrap, IAM roles, shared VPC, and quota manifests (so we can regenerate requests). Put those in infra-provisioning repo.
ops-bot: Reminder: attach the cross-cloud checklist template: https://go/internal/checklists/cross-cloud-provisioning (internal).
maria: Action items: Ajay - draft GCP quota requests + cost calc (due EOD), Darren - file AWS Service Quotas tickets (today), Lucy - open Azure quota requests and tag policy PR (tomorrow), Sam - repo scaffolding & terraform module PR (end of week). I'll own the org/billing link and budget alerts.
darren: Filed initial AWS requests for us-west-2: increase `p4d` to 8, `g4dn` to 32, EC2 running instances to 200, ENI limit to 120. Ticket IDs: SQ-78234, SQ-78235. Will paste links once they come back.
ajay: Draft submitted for GCP; requested `accelerator.googleapis.com`=8 (us-west2) and 4 (eu-west1), `CPUS` bumped accordingly. Ticket: gcp-quota-5591.
lucy: Azure request created: quota ID AZ-33921 for NDv4=8 WestUS2, NDv4=4 NorthEurope. Also requested Public IPs + vCPU bumps.
maria: Perfect — once quotas are approved, we'll run a smoke deploy to verify node provisioning and autoscaling policies. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
